explanation: There are two distinct specialist concepts in SA3: (1) SPECIALIST_RULE_CANDIDATE objects (5 candidates in canonical-candidates.jsonl, containing 5 primary rules whose disposition is SYNTHESIZED_INTO_PROPOSAL), and (2) RETAINED_SEPARATELY rules (4 rules in rule-dispositions.jsonl that are standalone specialist tools with disposition RETAINED_SEPARATELY pointing to RETAIN-RULE-PONY-* target IDs). These represent 9 distinct rules in total (5 synthesized + 4 retained separately).

specialistCandidates.statement: In Android CameraX capture pipelines, handle hardware-dependent feature parity fallbacks explicitly (auto-focus and flash variations across physical sensors).
Collect production iOS performance telemetry using MetricKit async diagnostic payload subscribers, buffering metrics across system report deliveries.
In geocoding and reverse geocoding workflows, gracefully handle empty results, network timeouts, and rate limits without throwing unhandled exceptions.
In APNs push notification implementations, request user alert/sound authorization before attempting device token registration callback handling.
When implementing Android BackupAgent credential restore keys, complete credential retrieval inside onRestoreFinished callback rather than onRestore.
